title: Braided octagons of a Roman mosaic (Hippo Regius)
subtitle: Roman mosaic, Hippone (Annaba)

construction.note: The finished design was read from Brian Wichmann’s ROMAN11 drawing, the centre lines of its bands snapped to exact values. We devised the construction: four lines cross at each of A, B, C and D, halving the angles there. The drawing gives no steps.
construction.changes: The compass steps, their order and the named points are ours. The comparison with the drawing checks the finished lines, not how the design was first laid out. Wichmann draws the lines as bevelled bands, and the floor has thick braids; the tutorial draws their centre lines. No photo of the floor was checked.

credits.source: Tiling Search, data192/ROMAN11: Roman mosaic, Hippone-Annaba
credits.creator: Brian Wichmann
credits.note: The design was read from his drawing, after Catherine Balmelle et al., Le décor géométrique de la mosaïque romaine (Picard, 2002), plate 413 b, a floor at Hippone (Annaba). The construction is ours.

given.A: The point where four bands cross, halfway from O to the next octagon on its side.

steps.text: Draw a horizontal straight line through O and A. Draw a circle with centre O through A.

Draw a vertical line through O. The two lines cross the circle at A, B, C and D. Draw a vertical line through each of A and B. Draw a horizontal line through each of C and D. These lines make the square cell, with corners K1, K2, K3 and K4. Draw a straight line through O and K1.
steps.textWithoutHelpers: Draw a vertical line through O. The two lines cross the circle at A, B, C and D. Draw a vertical line through each of A and B. Draw a horizontal line through each of C and D. These lines make the square cell, with corners K1, K2, K3 and K4.

steps.text: Draw the lines through A that halve the angles OAC and OAD. Draw the line through A at 90° to each of them.
Turn the four lines through A round O by 90°, three times. They pass through C, B and D, and make an octagon round O.
Join K1, K2, K3 and K4 to mark the tile that repeats.

ink.text: Ink the octagon at O and the four bands through each of A, B, C and D. They close the darts and kites between the octagons.

pattern.text: Put copies of the square cell side by side. The bands run on from cell to cell and weave over and under.
